traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS are implemented and verified. The rule implementation provides an optional, disabled-by-default suggestion rule that recommends migrating from @story/@req to @supports, with conservative auto-fix behavior restricted to simple single-story patterns. It detects multi-story and mixed-annotation cases and reports them without attempting unsafe fixes. The new primary rule name traceability/prefer-supports-annotation is exposed alongside a deprecated alias traceability/prefer-implements-annotation, and both can be configured to 'off', 'warn', or 'error', while remaining absent from the recommended/strict presets by default. Legacy @story/@req annotations remain valid when the rule is disabled, and auto-fix output is constrained to forms that produce valid @supports annotations. Comprehensive Jest tests for this story pass, and user-facing documentation (migration guide and README) provides migration guidance, configuration examples, and behavior descriptions that match the implementation.
